paragraphs: Valarian Technologies is a dual-use technology company building critical tools to safeguard the future in an era of evolving global security challenges. You are looking for an experienced Senior MLOps / LLMOps Engineer to lead the deployment, monitoring, orchestration, and operational reliability of your production LLM applications and agentic AI platform. In this role you will bridge the gap between AI development and production infrastructure, ensuring multi-step agentic workflows, data pipelines, and retrieval‑augmented systems run reliably, securely, and at scale within a large‑scale Kubernetes environment.

I have built agentic Python services that integrate with PostgreSQL and expose CI‑driven endpoints triggered by github actions. By defining clear stakeholder requirements I delivered reproducible runs that satisfy llm expectations while maintaining strict version control. The same approach allowed rapid iteration on agentic logic and ensured consistent behaviour across test environments.

I applied churn modelling using XGBoost within an R framework, performing hyperparameter tuning to improve propensity prediction. The resulting models were evaluated against held‑out data, demonstrating measurable gains in machine learning accuracy. This experience directly satisfies the evaluation requirement and showcases my ability to translate statistical insight into reliable, production‑ready outputs.
